A Standard Action or Ability is an Action or Ability that is always available for Adventurers to use. Below is a list of the Standard Actions and Abilities
Throughout the game, Abilities and Actions on Adventurers, Intelligent Combatants, and Command Combatants will reference targets that are either
“opponents”, “allies”, or “figures.”  While opponents and allies refer to specific groups of figures, the word “figure” is used to refer to both opponents
Allies are figures that share the same goal and have no reason to hinder
each other in achieving that goal. They are depicted in Diagrams and
Encounters with a green border. If you're taking the turn of an Adventurer
or friendly Combatant Card depicted with a green border, all figures with
this green border are considered your allies. All Abilities that refer to
Allies on these cards refer to figures with green Borders. Meanwhile, all
figures depicted with a red border are considered your opponents.
Opponents are figures that oppose the Adventurers. They are depicted
in Diagrams and Encounters with a red border. If you're taking the turn
of an Intelligent Combatant Card depicted with a red border, all figures
with this red border are considered your allies. All Abilities that refer to
Allies on these cards refer to figures with red Borders. Meanwhile, all
figures depicted with a green border are considered your opponents. Any
